issue.title: test_agent_load_cli JSON tests hardcode machine=athena without pinning local_machine_label
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/test_agent_load_cli.py::test_cli_json_flag_emits_exact_report`

Fails on apollo because `_report_from_records` uses live `local_machine_label()` (`apollo`) while the tests assert `payload["machine"] == "athena"`. `tests/test_machine_capacity_report.py` pins athena with an autouse monkeypatch; this file does not. Sibling `test_json_shape_carries_report_provenance_and_metadata` fails the same way. Reproduced in ToolRun d243f53ccbb10c66be61de95c7d973bd and again with a focused pytest on unmodified master c687d8b6eb. Not intermittent.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails whenever local_machine_label() is not athena. tests/test_machine_capacity_report.py pins athena with an autouse monkeypatch; test_agent_load_cli.py does not. Reproduced twice on apollo: ToolRun d243f53ccbb10c66be61de95c7d973bd and a focused pytest on unmodified master c687d8b6eb. Sibling test_json_shape_carries_report_provenance_and_metadata fails the same way.
